verdict.rationale: Riskified's own docs state a chargeback guarantee covering all approved orders. They also document a chargeback notification endpoint and gateway integrations that feed chargebacks to Riskified, which supports the liability-shift core of the story. Missing for 10: clear coverage terms (reimbursement mechanics, eligible chargeback reason codes, exclusions, claim timelines), explicit reimbursement documentation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can shift fraud liability to the vendor — a chargeback guarantee that reimburses approved-then-disputed orders, with clear coverage terms

citations.quote: Riskified stands behind its chargeback guarantee for all approved orders.
Notifies Riskified that a chargeback has been submitted for a specific order.

The Chargeback Gateway Integration (CGI) framework enables seamless connectivity with leading payment gateways, including Adyen, Stripe, Braintree, and PayPal, to automatically receive chargeback data without requiring custom API implementations.
